name: Allergy Intolerance
description: A record of a clinical assessment of an allergy or intolerance; a propensity, or a potential risk to an individual, to have an adverse reaction on future exposure to the specified substance, or class of substance.

fields.name: clinicalStatus (CodeableConcept)
fields.description: The current status of the allergy. Possible values include: active, resolved, and inactive

fields.name: verificationStatus (CodeableConcept)
fields.description: If the allergy is on the patient's chart, this element specifies "confirmed". If it is a newly created allergy and still needs to be reconciled, it is "unconfirmed".

fields.name: patient(reference)
fields.description: Reference to a patient resource for whom the allergy is relevant.

searchParams.name: Resource ID (string)
searchParams.description: The Resource ID of the AllergyIntolerance resource.

searchParams.name: Patient ID(reference)
searchParams.description: The reference ID of the Patient resource.

name: Patient
